title: How to Explain Resume Gaps Without Raising Red Flags
description:
If you’re worried a resume gap is hurting your chances with employers or costing you interviews, this video will show you exactly how to explain it clearly — without raising red flags.

Because most of the time, the gap itself is not the problem.
The problem is when recruiters are left guessing.

In this video, I walk through exact, resume-ready examples for how to explain:
• A layoff
• A stay-at-home parent gap
• Medical or health-related leave

You’ll learn where to explain a resume gap, what employers actually care about, and how to frame time away from work professionally and confidently.

I’m Kate Kirchner, a career strategist with 20 years of experience helping job seekers turn resumes and job search strategies into interviews. And as a former stay-at-home mom myself, this topic really resonates with me, too.
